scope:
Paired same-process control of production speech.align on frozen evidence.

ASR/MMS, decoded waveforms and the model-assisted singing mask are reused from
run_alignment.py. Other DSP, CTC search, local review and final payload creation
run normally. This measures cached alignment, not full-song processing.
timingExclusions: Tracing, result comparison, hashing, JSON and all file writes

pairedControl.method: One imported final module graph; only verified changed AST function definitions toggle outside each timer. Three warmup pairs; 18 measured AB/BA alternating pairs. Same cache, waveforms, imports, process, exact frozen output per version. Raw ABBA remains a separate result; no samples removed.
